Should WHD name specific local maternity triage numbers on this page?

claimLedger.claim: Aim for 150 minutes moderate activity weekly including muscle strengthening; talk but not sing; start gently if new; do not start new vigorous activity such as running; avoid fall/impact sports and scuba; avoid prolonged supine lying later in pregnancy; stop if uncomfortable, too hot or unwell.
claimLedger.sourceSection: NHS · Exercise in pregnancy · Media last reviewed: 3 February 2026
claimLedger.limitations: UK public guidance; local maternity protocols in India may add condition-specific limits.

claimLedger.claim: If healthy with a normal pregnancy, continue or start regular activity; aim for ≥150 minutes moderate aerobic activity weekly; lists activities to avoid and warning signs to stop and call your ob-gyn.
claimLedger.sourceSection: ACOG · Exercise During Pregnancy (FAQ119) · Last updated: September 2024; Last reviewed: November 2025
claimLedger.limitations: US patient FAQ; discuss local antenatal advice in India.

claimLedger.claim: In the absence of obstetric or medical complications or contraindications, physical activity in pregnancy is safe and desirable; evaluate women with complications carefully before recommending activity.
claimLedger.sourceSection: ACOG · Committee Opinion 804 — Physical Activity and Exercise During Pregnancy and the Postpartum Period · April 2020 (October 2021 correction noted on page)
claimLedger.limitations: Full absolute-contraindication box was only partially visible on the fetched abstract page; patient FAQ warning signs used for the stop list.
